populations.name: Unseen trip
populations.exclusion: 240 primary-pool segments from trips below the four-trip-per-vehicle eligibility minimum

populations.name: October 2018
populations.assignment: Training Nov 2017-Jul 2018; validation Aug 2018; calibration Sep 2018; evaluation Oct 2018

populations.name: Single held-out area
populations.assignment: Two adjacent 1-km evaluation cells; remaining eligible trips split 80/10/10 percent
populations.exclusion: Trips touching evaluation cells or the one-cell buffer excluded from development

populations.name: Motorway-largest-share holdout
populations.assignment: Evaluation trips have motorway as largest speed-integrated road-class share; remaining eligible trips split 80/10/10 percent
populations.exclusion: All other segments from evaluation trips excluded from development

isolation: Every trip occurs in one role only; vehicles may recur across roles.
